decision.interpretation: Direction bug is reproduced and corrected in a non-mutating derived view. Exact fractional top-decile selection passes the 1e-12 toy and real-output boundary checks. Corrected inclusive rank still expands at ties; tie expansion is reported separately.
decision.promotion: not authorized; this is an estimator bug screen and does not establish target accuracy or authorize candidate mutation/integration

measure_before.frozen_rank_rule: ceil(n*(1-top_fraction)) accumulated descending, then include all scores at/above boundary

method.corrected_score_rule: exact fractional highest top_fraction edge mass; all score groups above boundary plus a uniform fractional weight on the boundary tie group, applied to total and non-named clipped lengths
method.frozen_score_delta: corrected exact-fractional T4 gap minus frozen T4 gap
method.rank_direction_fix: descending accumulation uses target rank ceil(n*top_fraction), not ceil(n*(1-top_fraction))
method.tie_diagnostic_rule: separately compute corrected-direction integer-rank inclusive share; its excess above top_fraction is tie expansion, not rank-direction error
method.weight: endpoint connector incidence degree(u)*degree(v), eligible provided road classes from frozen T4 recipe
